name: legal-toolkit-from-andrea
description: A growing library of litigation skills: court-filing formatting, PDF-to-text conversion, court-filing PDF renaming, calendar-true date checking, NY Tanbook citation formatting, offline Bankruptcy Code lookup, case-law research and memo drafting (CourtListener), a full AI cite-check pipeline (eyecite + CourtListener + Isaacus), and a shared first-run setup that tailors every skill to your machine, identity, and jurisdictions. Identity-, DMS-, and jurisdiction-agnostic.
